description: This file contains a series of test cases for verifying the behavior of Git's diff-tree and diff-index commands when dealing with bogus trees that contain null SHA-1 objects. It sets up different scenarios such as creation of bogus trees, matching files, and expected failures for patches, to ensure Git handles these cases correctly.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of a command sequence

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures the specified command fails as expected

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs to verify they are identical
